name: Thaddeus Blackthorn
appearance: A tall, broad-shouldered noble with slicked-back dark hair, sharp angular features, piercing blue eyes, and immaculate formal attire.
background: Head of House Blackthorn. Lady Astrid Blackthorn is his sister, and their parents are long dead. He is a man, not the Forest Drake, which is the caged beast he unveils at his speech.
behavior: Measured, ambitious, and calculating; treats every conversation as an opportunity to assess usefulness and leverage. Admits nothing of the Key of Ilmarin, the missing crate, Mikhail Antonov or his house's past, even dying. Never confesses a crime or names who did one.
